lines.1: 「We should be safe now that we've made it this far.」
lines.2: 「You were Mr. Izu Oshima, the second-year, right?」
lines.5: 「Ah, damn it. That guy had to be wearing a ring.」
lines.7: She held one out to me.
lines.8: 「That's a pretty fancy pattern. You like this kind of thing?」
lines.10: She glared at me, so I looked away.
lines.11: 「I could have handled that much by myself.」
lines.12: 「Shut up! I wanted to leave you to die too! I don't give a damn about you! But my body moved on its own.」
lines.14: 「Damn, it hurts. It's throbbing. Lesson learned... I'm never letting the moment carry me away again.」
lines.15: 「I'll wash the handkerchief and return it.」
lines.16: 「Don't bother. It's filthy now. You can keep it.」
lines.22: 「Besides, I sincerely regret helping you, so at least I'm not pretending to be a hero.」
lines.23: 「I don't consider myself to have been rescued.」
lines.24: 「Yeah, yeah. Sorry I was so weak!」
lines.25: 「But groups are dangerous. Human beings are the scariest things in this world.」
lines.26: 「You should try to turn people down a little more tactfully.」
lines.27: 「If there'd been some hysterical girl in that crowd, she might've carved up your face with a box cutter.」
lines.28: 「Don't you watch too many dramas and read too much manga?」
lines.29: 「I've seen something close to it happen for real.」
lines.30: Damn it! Now I was thinking about that Konoe incident again.
lines.32: 「That's why I've decided not to get swept up in the moment or stick my neck into things that don't concern me.」
lines.33: 「I'd hate to have some incomprehensible idiot ruin my life.」
lines.34: 「If you thought it was dangerous, why did you help me?」
lines.35: 「Like I said, my body moved on its own. There was nothing I could do about it.」
lines.39: 「Actually, don't say anything too accurate or painful. My body's already hurting; I can't take my heart hurting too.」
lines.42: 「But that isn't what I wanted to say.」
lines.43: 「...Unwanted or not, a debt is still a debt.」
lines.45: 「If you barged in and got hurt and I did nothing, it would leave a bad taste in my mouth. I want to repay you quickly.」
lines.47: 「I suppose I could buy you one meal in the cafeteria.」
lines.48: 「So you do feel a little grateful.」
lines.49: 「Wouldn't I be the worst if I just left without doing anything?」
lines.50: 「...I can easily imagine you doing exactly that.」
lines.52: 「I didn't help you so I could hold it over your head.」
lines.55: Wait. This was the perfect opportunity!
lines.56: 「Hold on. There is one thing after all.」
lines.60: 「I'd really appreciate it if you joined.」
lines.65: 「But only as a temporary substitute until you find someone else.」
lines.67: 「...I have no intention of thanking you. But since I owe you now, I will repay the debt.」
lines.69: 「I thought you were just some stupid girl who couldn't function in society.」
lines.73: She planned to take away my voice before tormenting me.
lines.75: 「...That said, if the student council people are unpleasant, I won't join even temporarily.」
lines.76: 「For now, I'll be on the rooftop tomorrow.」
lines.78: It seemed she was at least somewhat grateful.
lines.79: She wouldn't say thank you, but she would repay a debt.
lines.80: That was very like her, somehow.
lines.81: Helping her had been worth it after all.
lines.82: Now I just had to check on Subaru.
